description: This file defines a Redux-Observable epic for creating questions, including functions for processing challenge files into markdown, inserting editable regions, and generating forum post URLs based on challenge data.

methods.name: filesToMarkdown
methods.description: Converts challenge files array into markdown formatted string, including file descriptions based on file extension and count.

methods.name: insertEditableRegions
methods.description: Inserts user editable region comments into challenge files that have editable boundaries.

methods.name: editableRegionsToMarkdown
methods.description: Converts challenge files with editable regions into markdown, highlighting the editable sections.

methods.name: linksOrMarkdown
methods.description: Generates links or markdown for project form values, transforming editor links.

methods.name: createQuestionEpic
methods.description: Redux-Observable epic that triggers on createQuestion action, processes challenge data, and opens a forum post URL with challenge info.
